title: FLUX.3 Image Klein Base on H200: four frameworks
description: Cross-framework single-request latency for FLUX.3 Image Klein Base (text-to-image, 1024x1024, 50 steps, CFG 3.5, the case's frozen upsampled caption) on one 2xH200 rx devbox, at two GPUs and one GPU: sglang main, ComfyUI master, vLLM-Omni PR #9007 (pre-merge, labeled, outside the committed matrix) and diffusers main as a one-GPU reference.

benchmark_repo.runner: scripts/devbox_run_cases.sh (run_comparison --modes single_e2e) on variant configs; diffusers via diffusers_ref.py
benchmark_repo.variant_config: Built on the box from configs/comparison_configs.json at 36e76e3: (1) a copy of the case with id flux3_klein_base_t2i_1024_1gpu, num_gpus 1, sglang serve_args '--model-type diffusion --warmup-mode server --enable-cfg-parallel false --performance-mode speed'; (2) ComfyUI models mapped to the Base repo (model.safetensors, ae.safetensors, merge of text_encoder), serve_args --gpu-only, params.cfg_gpus 2 on the two-GPU case, compile on/off arms; (3) a vllm-omni cell with model_path = the 6d332ea7 snapshot dir and serve_args '--cfg-parallel-size N --served-model-name black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-base'. The committed case now carries (2).

runtime.hardware: rx devbox flux3x-h200, 2x NVIDIA H200 141 GB, driver 595.71.05

model_revisions.note: Weight blobs (model.safetensors, ae.safetensors, text_encoder shards, tokenizer, chat template) are identical across 6d332ea7, 3f7fa5ee and f66af34f; only modular_model_index.json differs.

workload.prompt: the case prompt: 303-word upsampled caption, md5 b0e44fd9c061 (see the case notes)

policy.latency_source: client-side wall clock, median of 5 measured requests after warmup
policy.precision: native BF16 everywhere; full-precision attention (sglang FA, vLLM-Omni FLASH_ATTN); no quantized checkpoint, no cache
policy.compile: sglang eager (cookbook); vLLM-Omni regional compile; ComfyUI compile at one GPU, eager at two (compile breaks the MultiGPU CFG split); diffusers eager reference
policy.pre_merge: vLLM-Omni rows measure an open PR and are labeled; the committed matrix keeps the cell unsupported until it merges

two_gpus.comfyui (compile + CFG split): failed: torch._dynamo TorchRuntimeError Tensor device mismatch (cuda:1, cuda:0)

comfyui (eager).note: two GPUs visible, cfg_gpus 1 (one GPU used)

files.raw/run_flux3x_sglang_2gpu.json: sglang two-GPU row; its comfyui (403) and vllm-omni (vllm 0.30.0) rows are superseded by the files below
files.raw/run_flux3x_sglang_1gpu.json: sglang one-GPU row; same superseded rows
files.failures/run_flux3x_comfyui_2gpu_compile: ComfyUI two GPUs, compile + cfg_gpus 2: failed
files.images/: 512x512 copies of one output each from ComfyUI (one GPU), vLLM-Omni (one GPU) and diffusers

reproduce: See summary.md 'What each row needed'. sglang and ComfyUI rows follow the committed case; vLLM-Omni needs VLLM_INSTALL_SPEC=vllm==0.31.0 VLLM_OMNI_INSTALL_SPEC=git+https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni.git@389a02a149ced03a9550368565571fff9d1d99f3 and the variant cell described under benchmark_repo.variant_config.
